title: Two-Path Test for Limit Non-Existence
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Show that lim_{(x, y) -> (0, 0)} (xy) / (x^2 + y^2) does not exist by approaching along lines y = mx.
finalAnswer: \text{Limit does not exist; value depends on slope } m: \frac{m}{1 + m^2}

steps.title: Substitute Straight Line Path y = mx
steps.explanation: Cancel factor of x^2 from numerator and denominator.
steps.why: Evaluating limit along linear family of paths.

steps.title: Compare Different Slope Values
steps.explanation: Approaching along the x-axis gives 0, while approaching along y = x gives 1/2.
